title: Routledge's Manual of Etiquette
author: George Routledge

authorInfo.bio: George Routledge (1812–1888) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.
authorInfo.edition: Complete source text and original edition credits retained.

description: "Routledge's Manual of Etiquette" by George Routledge is a detailed guide on social manners and conduct written during the late 19th century. The book covers a wide range of topics relevant to social interactions, including etiquette for introductions, courtship, dining, and dancing.
rights: Source edition: public domain in the United States. Named creative contributors screened for India, UK and EU; original licence retained.
